text:
Raj Patel: Quick postmortem — thanks everyone for co-hosting the CloudMarketplace + HW partner webinar. Need to sync on recording, marketplace listing timing, demo artifacts, and swag returns. Who owns: editing + CDN copy, co-branded landing page, marketplace listing date, hardware partner follow-up (logs + access), swag surplus pickup? Prefer owners + ETA by EOD. cc @Sophia Chen @Mike Liu

Sophia Chen: I'll own landing page + email nurture. Target Tue EOD for assets. Can design ops get final logos by end of day? Also: do we want marketplace listing same week as on-demand launch or wait for Partner legal signoff? :thinking_face:

Mike Liu: I can own the video editing and trimmed demo clips. Need the raw recording + demo VM logs. ETA Wed noon if I get the files today. @deploy-bot can you drop the raw recording link and the Mux ID?

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://storage.redwood.co/recordings/2876543210_master.mp4
Mux ID: mux_abc123
Auto-transcript: https://transcripts.redwood.co/2876543210.vtt

Anna Gomez: I'll coordinate partner legal + marketplace scheduling. Suggest we wait 48 hrs for HW partner to confirm demo reproducibility before marketplace listing. Will ping legal and get back by tomorrow AM.

Raj Patel: Ok. For swag: We shipped extra stickers and notebooks. Partner prefers local pickup; can someone schedule courier? @Sophia?

Sophia Chen: Yep, I'll book courier for partner office on Fri. Also sharing co-brand guidelines in this thread in 5. Need final speaker slides (pdf) for the landing page.

Mike Liu: Slides incoming — I'll export PDFs and the short demo snippets. Also attaching a quick run-of-show snippet for the trimmed clip timestamps:
```
00:00 Intro
03:12 Demo start
11:45 Key benchmark
16:20 Q&A highlight
```
Use clips 03:00-12:00 and 16:00-17:30.

Raj Patel: Perfect. Can we also surface the Marketplace SKU mapping? We need SKU, pricing model, and minimal config for install. Anna can you capture that with the partner?

Anna Gomez: Will collect SKU + pricing. Also need to confirm whether partner wants co-billing or referral. Putting together a small checklist:
- legal signoff
- demo reproducibility logs
- SKU/pricing
- slides + captions
- on-demand landing page
- marketplace listing date
I'll share Trello card.

Sophia Chen: Trello card link please. Also need headshots and bio for the partner speaker to publish. @Raj can you nudge them for 1-paragraph bio?

Raj Patel: Sent DM to partner rep. They replied 'sending bios and invoices today'.

Mike Liu: One more note: the hardware partner supplied a kernel patch for perf. We should include a short appendix in the delivery notes with the patch ID: patch-hw-7721. Tagging eng-ops for follow-up.

Anna Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll add patch reference to the marketplace notes. Next steps owners:
- Mike: editing + clips (Wed noon)
- Sophia: landing page + courier (Tue page, Fri courier)
- Anna: legal + marketplace scheduling (tomorrow AM)
- Raj: partner liaison + bios (today)
If anyone needs to change ETA say now.

Sophia Chen: All good from marketing. I'll prepare the email nurture copy draft and drop it in #marketing for review tomorrow.

Raj Patel: Thanks team. Closing this thread — will update Trello and ping again once legal clears. :white_check_mark:
